## Verification

- [ ] JSON records and schemas validate.
- [ ] Decision-table and workflow references remain consistent.
- [ ] Generic-core boundary is preserved.
- [ ] Accessibility and format-specific checks are complete or documented.
- [ ] Human reviewers and authorization owner are identified.
- [ ] Rollback or recovery approach is documented.

## Decision record

State the recommendation, unresolved conditions, evidence location, and authorization status. A merged pull request does not by itself authorize an asset for operational release.
